name: Relay — LinkedIn Email Finder & Outreach
description: Find work emails on LinkedIn and run outreach from your own Gmail. Email fires up front, LinkedIn crawls behind. Safety caps.
//permissions: unlimitedStorage: email templates carry base64 attachments, which blow past chrome.storage.local's default 10 MB quota.
//optional_host_permissions: Self-hosted tracking: the user can point Relay at their own endpoint on any origin, which is requested at save time rather than demanded up front.

content_scripts.//js: mail-core is deliberately NOT injected: every email decision is made in the service worker, so the page only needs the sequence brain + the Voyager action layer.
